```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# File description: 
# Builds a summary table of data collection progress for all tools

# Instructions:
# See make.r for how to execute code in correct order
# Before running this file, pull new data from API (./src/set-up/pull-data.R)

rm(list = ls())

library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(tibble)
library(haven)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(ggrepel)
library(openxlsx)
library(here)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(glue)
library(httr2)

# load helper functions
source(here("src", "monitoring", "helper-functions.R"))

# load data
datA <- readRDS(here("data", "facilityMNCH-toolA.rds")) %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
#datB <- readRDS(here("data", "facilityMNCH-toolB.rds")) %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
#datC <- readRDS(here("data", "facilityMNCH-toolC.rds")) %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
#datD <- readRDS(here("data", "facilityMNCH-toolD.rds")) %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
```


```{css, echo=FALSE}
/* tighten row height across all tables in this document */
table td, table th {
  padding-top: 2px !important;
  padding-bottom: 2px !important;
  line-height: 1.1;
}

/* caption spans the full page width, independent of table width */
.table-caption {
  width: 100%;
  font-weight: bold;
  margin-top: 1.2em;
  margin-bottom: 0.4em;
  display: block;
}
```

# Data collection monitoring

```{r results='asis'}
# Summary data
datA %>%
  mutate(Tool = "A") %>%
  select(Tool, SubmissionDate, t_level1, level2, level3, t_f01) %>%
  arrange(t_level1, level2) %>%
  compact_kable(col.names = c("Tool",
                              "SubmissionDate","State", 
                              "Level2", "Level3",
                              "Facility name"))
```
